reason: Nothing here tells me it plugs into my website, POS or WooCommerce, and I'm not going to have staff copy-paste order confirmations into a portal in the middle of 11.11. For the sale blast itself, my customers already read WhatsApp, which costs me nothing.
objection: No mention of an API or WooCommerce/POS plugin, so for a multi-branch store it looks like manual work, and I'm not convinced SMS beats WhatsApp for my customers.
would_change_my_mind: A ready WooCommerce/POS integration or documented API that sends order and delivery confirmations automatically under my sender name, set up in a day.
